results.title: Everything Legendary: Funding, Team & Investors | Startup Intros
results.content:
Based in Upper Marlboro, Maryland, Everything Legendary manufactures premium plant-based burger patties and ground meat products utilizing a blend of pea and hemp protein. The company distributes its vegan meat alternatives through direct-to-consumer channels and major grocery retailers, securing retail shelf space at national chains like Target and Walmart. Following a facility expansion, the enterprise reached a manufacturing capacity of 160,000 burgers per hour to supply an initial retail footprint of over 1,500 physical stores. To support this ongoing commercial expansion, the business appointed entrepreneur Russell Simmons as a senior board adviser. Everything Legendary has raised $6.3 million in total funding, highlighted by a $6 million Series A financing round backed by prominent [...] Loading organizations...
